# Newsreel recipe

An early sound newsreel. A silver picture sits in a rounded projector gate with black either side. A searchlight-and-globe ident opens; a newspaper spins into the lens and slams down; place-and-date cards, a starred route map, grease-pencil rings, wipes, flips and irises follow. Flicker, weave, scratches and dust cover everything, and a dark subtitle strip runs along the bottom. This is an editing style: the era lives in how plausible material is arranged, cut and captioned, not in a drawing technique.

## Look
- Gate: 1.37:1 picture, 1480 x 1080, centred in 1920 x 1080 at full height, 26 px rounded corners, pure black outside. Draw nothing beyond the gate.
- Film the news objects (spin, slam, push in, ring them): newspapers, maps, documents. Never typeset them like slides.
- Each segment: a single story, a single place, a single kind of material. Stories shorten toward the end, then one held button closes.
- Transitions belong to the reel: iris, diagonal hard wipe with a bright edge, vertical-axis flip. Use each once, as punctuation. No cross-dissolves, whip pans or zoom blur.
- Not a documentary with a vintage filter: no talking heads, slow drifts, modern lower-thirds. Not a drawn silent comedy: the pencil marks are the only hand-inked element.
- The user's footage from `list_media` replaces any stand-in picture. Convert it to greyscale with one level set per clip, then run it through the same projector layer. Never fabricate "archive" photographs.

## Surfaces
- Two layers. Film look goes on the picture layer (paper, map, ident). Keep the type layer (place cards, odometer, subtitles) sharp. Pencil marks are part of the picture and weave with it.
- Projection: vignette from transparent to 62 % black; per-frame flicker of +-3.5 % with a 3 Hz drift on top; gate weave +-1.6 px horizontal and +-2.2 px vertical, from summed sines; 0-3 one-pixel vertical scratches, each lasting 9 frames at 24 fps; 0-4 dust specks per frame. Drive all of it from timeline time and a seeded hash. Never use random.
- Newsprint: warm grey paper, near-black ink at lifted values, text columns as banded lines, a halftone-grey photo, double rules, a boxed price. Soft 40 px drop shadow, never coloured.
- Ident: 36 alternating sunburst wedges (5° wide, every 10°) rotating 30° over 4.4 s; two narrow cream searchlights with a gradient from 55 % to 0 opacity, swaying +-12.6°; a wire globe (silver radial gradient, six turning meridians, five latitude arcs).
- Map: generated coastline (polar noise), dashed borders and a river clipped to it, scanline ground. Route = separate dots; stars mark stops.

## Palette
- Warm silver monochrome; values do the work. Default tokens are the film's colours: ground `--latar #14120f`, silver `--utama #d8d0bf`, mid `--aksen #9e978a`, cream text `--teks #f3eee4`.
- `--latar` darkens the gate world (`--kelam`: 14 % of it blended into near-black), so even a pale brand gets a dark projection room. Cream text always sits on dark.
- `--utama` becomes the signal colour (`--sinyal`, lightened to read on dark): route dots, stars, odometer frame. `--aksen` tints the grease pencil, mixed toward white.
- Fixed for every brand: silver gradient lettering (`#fff → #d9d4ca | #9e978a → #efebe2`, hard break at the middle, dark outline), newsprint grey, ink, cream rules.
- Forbidden: colour wash, sepia overlay, colourised archive.

## Type
- Ident and end title: `--font-judul`, Limelight, 104-124 px, silver gradient, 12 px outline.
- Place card, labels, subtitles, odometer: `--font-isi`, Oswald. Card 30 px bold plus 24 px, letter-spacing 3-5 px. Subtitle 40 px over 29 px.
- Newspaper masthead: IM Fell English, 66 px. Headline, captions, deck: Playfair Display 700 and italic; headline 80 px, deck 34 px.
- Brand fonts replace Limelight and Oswald; leave extra room, titles run long. The newspaper keeps its print faces whatever the brand.
- Place card: top left of the gate (x 48, y 56). Dark box, inset 2 px cream frame, bold "PLACE · DATE" above one short line. Emerges from the left edge to the right in 0.22 s. Hold 2.5 s minimum.
- Subtitle strip: 200 px dark gradient over the gate's bottom edge, two lines (40 px, 29 px) with a dark stroke. Fade in 0.25 s ahead of the first cue. Never wrap.

## Timing
- Cut on strong beats, with a 190-220 BPM feel. Archive shots 1-2.5 s; print and documents 2.5-4 s. Nothing sits still past 1 s without a moving element.
- Spinning paper: scale `0.06 + 0.94·u^2.3`, rotation `−2.5 turns × (1−u)^1.25`, three ghost copies 18 ms apart at 22 % opacity, 0.85 s overall.
- Slam: damped sine jolt `16 px × e^(−14 d) × sin(70 d)` plus a 3 % scale bounce decaying as e^(−18 d); runs about 0.8 s.
- Push then punch: ease-in-out push to 1.12x over 1 s, a 0.14 s punch to about 1.55x on the detail, then a 3 % creep.
- Pencil ring: 1.12 turns in 0.28 s, then a thinner second pass offset by 2 px.
- Dotted route: dots 35 ms apart, each pops in 0.2 s; stars `back.out(3)`; counters ease in-out over roughly 1.8 s.
- Iris 0.4 s `power2`. Diagonal wipe 0.5 s, 10 px cream edge, 300 px slant. Flip 0.25 s each way.
- Ending: a held card of 2 s or more; only a 2-3 % creep and the projector's flicker move.

## Camera
- Spin-and-slam: paper arrives as news. Headline, notice, poster.
- Slow push, then a punch-in on the beat: whole page narrows to one detail. Headline into photo; a price.
- Map push: from region to one place. Routes, spread, launches.
- Freeze and jolt: halt on the telling frame. Punchline, evidence.
- Flip: turn to the next story. Closing card.
- Iris: entering or leaving a story. The opening and the first item.
- Reframe footage by about 6 % at most. Give stills a move that has a purpose.

## Signature moves
- Ident ritual: in the first 0.2 s the searchlights flash on; then the globe grows and spins, the name lands with overshoot, an iris closes on the globe. For: a town-history opening; a shop anniversary; a podcast season recap; a class reunion.
- Spinning paper: a printed page spins in, slams, then pushes to its single detail. For: a headline; a decree; a 1953 menu board; a club bulletin; a crowdfunding notice.
- Grease-pencil ring: after the punch-in, circle the telling detail in white pencil. For: a price; a date; a rule; a mystery clue.
- Map spread: route laid dot by dot, stars pulse on arrival, label cards, counter in the corner. For: delivery route; tour; a craze that spread; a pilgrimage.
- Place card: titles each segment, replacing full-screen cards. For: every story location in a documentary-style reel.
- Held end card: double deco frame drawn in 0.4 s, silver title lands, one line. For: a business signature; series end; event date.

## Avoid
- Grading each frame makes footage pump. One level per clip.
- Grain on the picture only. A second grain over text is wrong.
- Cross-dissolve, zoom blur or a modern lower-third ends the illusion.
- Place cards that vanish before they can be read: cut the words, not the hold.
- Transitions are punctuation. One use each.
- A light brand on a dark gate works; never set the gate on a pale ground.
- Jaunty grammar does not suit disasters or deaths.

# 1920s newsreel: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.2, medium 2.5, long 3.5.

## hook

- en: searchlights snap on with a flash, the wire globe grows and turns, the name lands with overshoot, an iris closes on the globe
- id: lampu sorot menyala dengan kilat, bola kawat tumbuh dan berputar, nama mendarat memantul, iris menutup di bola

## problem

- en: a newspaper spins into the lens and slams down; the headline states the trouble, a place-and-date card is pulled out left to right
- id: koran berputar ke lensa lalu menghantam meja; judulnya menyatakan masalah, kartu tempat dan tanggal ditarik dari kiri

## fact

- en: slam the paper, push to the detail on a beat and ring it in white grease pencil; the card names place and date
- id: koran dihantam, didorong ke detailnya tepat di ketukan, dilingkari pensil lemak putih; kartu menyebut tempat dan tanggal

## step

- en: a map spread: dotted route laid dot by dot, a star pulses at each stop, one label card per stop, a counter climbs in the corner
- id: peta: rute bertitik jatuh titik demi titik, bintang berdenyut di tiap perhentian, satu kartu tiap tempat, angka naik di pojok

## compare

- en: split screen: two panels slide in, each with a place-card label one beat apart; the winner pushes the other out of frame
- id: layar terbelah: dua panel meluncur masuk, masing-masing berlabel kartu berselang satu ketukan; yang menang mendorong yang lain keluar

## number

- en: an odometer in a double-framed box counts up beside the map or a print detail, then holds on the final figure
- id: penghitung di kotak berbingkai ganda naik di samping peta atau cetakan, lalu berhenti di angka akhir

## proof

- en: freeze the telling frame, jolt it, ring the detail with a hand-drawn loop in white pencil; subtitle strip names it
- id: bekukan bingkai yang bercerita, hentakkan, lingkari detailnya dengan pensil putih; strip subtitel menyebutnya

## offer

- en: a printed ad or price box slams down, the camera pushes onto it and a pencil underlines the figure
- id: iklan cetak atau kotak harga dihantam ke meja, kamera mendorong ke sana dan pensil menggaris bawahi angkanya

## cta

- en: end card in a double deco frame drawn in 0.4 s, silver title lands, contact line fades in; held 2 s
- id: kartu penutup berbingkai deco ganda digambar 0,4 detik, judul perak mendarat, kontak muncul; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: vertical flip to the end card: double frame drawn, silver title lands with overshoot, a closing line; held 2 s
- id: balik sumbu tegak ke kartu penutup: bingkai ganda digambar, judul perak memantul mendarat, satu kalimat penutup; diam 2 detik

      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): nilai awal = warna film aslinya, perak hangat. */
      :root {
        --latar: #14120f; --latar-2: #2a2723; --utama: #d8d0bf; --aksen: #9e978a;
        --teks: #f3eee4; --teks-redup: #b9b2a4; --teks-di-utama: #14120f; --teks-di-aksen: #14120f;
        --utama-di-latar: #d8d0bf; --aksen-di-latar: #b9b2a4;
        --font-judul: "Limelight", "Noto Sans", serif; --font-isi: "Oswald", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Dunia proyektor: gelap mengikuti latar brand, perak dan cetakan tetap. */
        --nol: #000; --kelam: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 14%, #0c0b0a); --krem: #f3eee4; --krem-2: #d6cfc0;
        --ray-a: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kelam) 80%, white); --ray-b: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kelam) 97%, white);
        --perak-1: #ffffff; --perak-2: #d9d4ca; --perak-3: #9e978a; --perak-4: #efebe2;
        --kertas: #cfc7b4; --tinta: #2a2620; --peta: #c9c0aa;
        --sinyal: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 55%, white); --pensil: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 30%, #faf8f0);

      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--nol); }

      #hl { top: 158px; font: 700 80px/1 var(--font-koran); }
      #deck { top: 256px; font: italic 400 34px/1 var(--font-koran); }

      .cincin { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1300px; height: 880px; overflow: visible; }
      .cincin path { fill: none; stroke: var(--pensil); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

      #peta { background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 70% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--kelam) 75%, white), var(--kelam)), repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 3px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--nol) 22%, transparent) 3px 4px); }

      .kartu { position: absolute; padding: 14px 24px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kelam) 82%, transparent); outline: 2px solid var(--krem-2); outline-offset: -7px; color: var(--krem); white-space: nowrap; clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }

      .kartu span { display: block; font: 500 24px/1.3 var(--font-isi); letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--krem-2); }

      .sub p { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 100%; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--krem); font: 500 40px/1 var(--font-isi); -webkit-text-stroke: 6px var(--kelam); paint-order: stroke fill; }

      .bingkai { fill: none; stroke: var(--krem-2); stroke-width: 3px; }

      #kilat { inset: 0; background: var(--krem); opacity: 0; }

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const { sin, cos, exp, floor, abs, PI } = Math;
      const hs = (n) => { const x = sin(n * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453; return x - floor(x); };
      const el = (tag, attrs, parent) => {
        const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);

      // Sinar matahari, bola kawat (meridian diputar dari skrip), foto bus, peta.

        el("rect", { x: 300, y: 110, width: 40, height: 100, rx: 6, style: lt }, bus);

        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
          const x = 20 + i * 44 + hs(i) * 14, hh = 40 + hs(i + 9) * 22;
          el("circle", { cx: x, cy: 270 - hh, r: 11, style: ink }, bus);
          el("rect", { x: x - 12, y: 281 - hh, width: 24, height: hh, rx: 9, style: ink }, bus);
        }
        // pulau dari derau kutub berbiji, batas kabupaten dan sungai
        const pts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
          const a = (i / 120) * 2 * PI, r = 1 + 0.2 * sin(3 * a + 1) + 0.11 * sin(5 * a + 2.2) + 0.06 * sin(9 * a + 0.5);
          pts.push(`${(516 + 400 * r * cos(a)).toFixed(1)} ${(800 + 600 * r * sin(a)).toFixed(1)}`);
        }
        const d = "M" + pts.join("L") + "Z";
        $("#pulau").setAttribute("d", d);
        $("#pulau2").setAttribute("d", d);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const y0 = 330 + i * 300 + hs(i + 3) * 80;
          el("path", { class: "batas", d: `M80 ${y0}Q516 ${y0 + 120 * (hs(i) - 0.5)} 950 ${y0 + 160 * (hs(i + 5) - 0.5)}` }, $("#dalam"));

        el("path", { class: "sungai", d: "M200 1300Q420 1120 460 940T700 640T820 300" }, $("#dalam"));

        $("#f1").setAttribute("d", frame(60, 160, 912, 1440, 40));

      }
      // Lingkaran pensil lemak (1.12 putaran) dan bingkai deco bersudut kipas.
      function ring(cx, cy, rx, ry) {
        let s = "";
        for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
          const a = -2.2 + (i / 63) * 2 * PI * 1.12, r = 1 + 0.05 * sin(i * 0.7);

      function frame(x, y, w, h, c) {
        return `M${x + c} ${y}H${x + w - c}Q${x + w - c} ${y + c} ${x + w} ${y + c}V${y + h - c}Q${x + w - c} ${y + h - c} ${x + w - c} ${y + h}H${x + c}Q${x + c} ${y + h - c} ${x} ${y + h - c}V${y + c}Q${x + c} ${y + c} ${x + c} ${y}Z`;

      build();

      const d1 = arc(A, [300, 940], B, 22), d2 = arc(B, [520, 560], C, 20);

      const pics = $$(".pic"), gor = $$(".gor"), deb = $$(".deb"), flk = $(".flk"), jolt = $("#jolt");

          e.style.left = hs(id * 2.1) * 1032 + "px";
          e.style.top = hs(id * 5.1) * 700 + "px";
          e.style.height = 900 + hs(id * 6.3) * 700 + "px";
        });
        const n = floor(hs(f * 0.91) * 5);
